751-4068-6723.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
751-4068-6723.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

719-4693-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-4693-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat from step 3.

2178-2292-2380.easyPrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
2178-2292-2380.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

5531-5694-6763-6927-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
5531-5694-6763-6927-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Damage Control Crew and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Damage Control Crew and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Damage Control Crew trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
5531-5694-6763-6927-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Damage Control Crew and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3249-5687--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-5687--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4681-5170-6495-6634.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

1429-4659-4981.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Repeat.

348-1152-2992-6026-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-2992-6026-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Field of Souls triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

1806-2060-6798-7367-7741.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Shang-Chi.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2067-7278.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
When the Pegasi enter, Slash triggers that many times, dealing twice that much damage to each opponent.

3259-4359-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
3259-4359-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

1545-2308-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
1545-2308-4050-4871.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Trostani triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-1879-3899-6753.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1409-4365-4716.description:
Activate Prosperous Innkeeper by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Prosperous Innkeeper.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

Repeat.

4659-4763--21--45.description:

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Koll triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

252-4359-4871.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-4359-4871.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

2981-5394-6291.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

392-1356-2060-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.

Rocco's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and creating a Food token.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

1309-1987-4276-4863.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1309-1987-4276-4863.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and Revolutionist.
When Salvager of Secrets and Revolutionist enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1309-1987-4276-4863.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1429-2292-4875-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2292-4875-5402.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2239-5626-5733.manaNeeded: {5}{U} the first turn, with {7}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
2239-5626-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
You have at least {E}.
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2239-5626-5733.description:
Deal combat damage using a Rogue
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}, sacrificing Ardent Elementalist, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1909-3043-4486.notablePrerequisites: Axebane Guardian does not have summoning sickness. You control at least two creatures with defender.
1909-3043-4486.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Repeat.
1909-3043-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

3000-5670-5933.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-5670-5933.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

1322-3259-5659.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-5659.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1479-3756-4493.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a token copy of Kodama of the East Tree that isn't legendary.
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
Kodama of the East Tree, the Kodama of the East Tree token, and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield.
The Kodama of the East Tree token and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Kodama of the East Tree with haste.
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
Both Kodama of the East Trees and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

3438-4552-4944.description:
Activate Inkmoth Nexus's second ability by paying {0}, causing it to become a 1/1 Blinkmoth creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Inkmoth Nexus's second ability by paying {0}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

316-837-2440-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five other Griffins.
316-837-2440-3263.description:
Activate Seal of Removal by sacrificing it, returning Griffin Dreamfinder to your hand.
Cast Griffin Dreamfinder by paying {5}.
When Griffin Dreamfinder enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Griffin Dreamfinder trigger, returning Seal of Removal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {6}.
Cast Seal of Removal by paying {1}.
Repeat.
If you control seven or more Griffins, this combo nets infinite mana.

4316-5004-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Cathodion on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Cathodion's power.
Cast Cathodion from the top of your library by paying {3}.
Repeat.

1494-1908-2646.notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
1494-1908-2646.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Sage of Hours that enters the battlefield with at least five +1/+1 counters due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate the Sage of Hours token by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1006-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Wolfhunter's Quiver attached to Famished Paladin.
You have a way to give Famished Paladin lifelink.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
1006-3957.description:
Give Famished Paladin lifelink, if needed.
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

2577-4871-4924.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
2577-4871-4924.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Gravecrawler enters the battlefield as a 1/0 due to Heartless Summoning, and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

224-427-3148-4067.notablePrerequisites:

Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
224-427-3148-4067.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Thrasios by paying {4}, causing you to scry 1, then reveal the top card of your library and put it onto the battlefield tapped if it's a land, or draw a card otherwise.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Kydele.
Otherwise, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.

1385-2438-2530-2577.description:

Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder's ability, putting a +1/+1counter on it.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard to the battlefield by paying {B}.
Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and adding {B}.
Repeat.

1081-1623.notablePrerequisites: You have any enchantment in hand with the mana to cast it.
1081-1623.description:
Cast any enchantment.
Presence of the Master triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger, exiling the instant and casting it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
